items.exampleEn: She blithely assumed that the train would wait for her.
items.exampleZh: 她滿不在乎地以為火車會等她。
items.glossZh: 滿不在乎地；漫不經心地

items.exampleEn: The article sarcastically praised the city for its beautiful traffic jams.
items.exampleZh: 那篇文章諷刺地稱讚這座城市「美麗的」塞車。

items.exampleEn: The small boat moved aimlessly with the wind on the lake.
items.exampleZh: 那艘小船在湖上隨風漫無目的地漂動。

items.exampleEn: The famous chef was talented but temperamental.
items.exampleZh: 那位知名主廚很有才華，但喜怒無常。
items.glossZh: 喜怒無常的；（機器）時好時壞的

items.exampleEn: It was a gutsy decision to leave a safe job and travel the world.
items.exampleZh: 辭掉安穩的工作去環遊世界，是個很有膽量的決定。

items.exampleEn: The film has a dark, macabre sense of humor.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影的幽默感黑暗又陰森。
items.glossZh: 陰森恐怖的；以死亡為題材的

items.exampleEn: Flattery will get you nowhere with this teacher.
items.exampleZh: 對這位老師拍馬屁是沒有用的。

items.exampleEn: The once docile class became noisy after lunch.
items.exampleZh: 原本乖巧安靜的班級，午餐後變得吵鬧起來。

items.sentenceEn: The tourists wandered aimlessly through the old market.
items.sentenceZh: 遊客們漫無目的地在老市場裡閒逛。

items.audioEn: My old car is temperamental: some mornings it starts at once, and some mornings it won't start at all.
items.audioZh: 我的舊車時好時壞：有些早上一發就動，有些早上卻怎麼也發不動。
options: It works on some days but not on others.
It is too small for the family.

items.sentenceEn: It takes a gutsy player to try a shot like that.
items.sentenceZh: 要有膽量的球員才敢那樣出手。

items.sentenceEn: He answered sarcastically, so I knew he was annoyed.
items.sentenceZh: 他語帶諷刺地回答，所以我知道他不高興了。

items.stemEn: Many readers enjoy her ____ stories about ghosts and old graves.
items.stemZh: 很多讀者喜歡她那些關於鬼魂和古墓、陰森恐怖的故事。

items.stemEn: Don't let his ____ fool you; he only says nice things when he wants something.
items.stemZh: 別被他的奉承騙了，他只有在想要東西的時候才會說好聽話。

items.passageEn: My aunt Rosa is a writer known for her slightly macabre short stories, which usually take place in old houses at night. In person, though, she is cheerful and gutsy: at sixty, she learned to ride a horse. Her horse, Kiko, is docile with children but temperamental with adults, and on Rosa's first day he refused to move. Her instructor said sarcastically that Kiko must have read her books. Rosa blithely ignored the comment and kept trying. When she is stuck on a story, she walks aimlessly around town until an idea comes. She prefers candid opinions to flattery, so when a fan once called her the best writer alive, she just laughed.
items.passageZh: 我的阿姨 Rosa 是位作家，以略帶陰森氣息的短篇故事聞名，故事通常發生在夜裡的老房子。不過，她本人開朗又有膽量：六十歲時學會了騎馬。她的馬 Kiko 對小孩很溫順，對大人卻喜怒無常；Rosa 第一天上課時，牠根本不肯動。她的教練諷刺地說，Kiko 一定讀過她的書。Rosa 滿不在乎地不理會這句話，繼續嘗試。每當故事寫不下去，她就在鎮上漫無目的地走來走去，直到靈感出現。比起奉承，她更喜歡坦白的意見，所以有一次一位書迷稱她是當今最好的作家時，她只是笑了笑。

questions.questionZh: Rosa 的馬對大人是什麼態度？
options: 非常溫順，很聽大人的話
很怕陌生人，一直躲起來

questions.questionZh: Rosa 寫不出故事時會怎麼做？
options: 去馬場騎馬，讓自己放鬆一下
打電話給出版社的編輯討論劇情
在鎮上漫無目的地走來走去

items.promptZh: 這隻狗看起來很兇，其實非常溫順。
referenceEn: This dog looks fierce, but it is actually very docile.
The dog may look scary, but in fact it is very docile.
rubricZh: 「溫順的」用 docile，可放 be 動詞後（例如 is very docile）
「看起來很兇」可寫，例如 looks fierce、looks scary 等
「其實」可寫，例如 actually、in fact 等

items.promptZh: 這位歌手喜怒無常，工作人員都很怕她。
referenceEn: The singer is so temperamental that the staff are all afraid of her.
The singer is temperamental, and all the staff are scared of her.
rubricZh: 「喜怒無常」用 temperamental（例如 so temperamental that…、is temperamental 等）
「工作人員都很怕她」可寫，例如 the staff are all afraid of her 等
